title: Prompt Caching
subtitle: How LLM providers reuse your context instead of re-reading it

chapters.title: The Re-Read Tax
chapters.blurb: Every request ships the whole transcript and the model re-reads all of it — the bill grows with the square of the conversation.

chapters.title: Byte-Identical or Bust
chapters.blurb: The cache key is the byte-identical prefix: tools, then system, then messages — one reordered tool and everything after is full price.

chapters.title: A Breakpoint and a Five-Minute Fuse
chapters.blurb: cache_control pins the stable prefix; a five-minute fuse, rewound on every hit, with a patient one-hour tier for slow loops.

chapters.title: The Crossover Math
chapters.blurb: Writes bill at 1.25x, reads at 0.1x — the cost lines cross before your second request finishes.

chapters.title: The Agent's Bill, Before and After
chapters.blurb: The same ten-turn agent run on both meters: 175,000 token-units uncached vs about 53,150 — roughly 70% off the input bill.
